reasons: A1 (No criterion ever reads a score cell that has a number in it) is blocking and nothing downstream catches it
rule: reject when any blocking finding is owned by 'nothing'; approve when every remaining finding sits in a column a downstream checker owns. An owner that can pass by not running is owned only conditionally: it approves, and the confirmation it actually ran is listed in verify_later
